items.title: Anthropic Expands Mythos 5 Access to More Defenders, Unveils $35M Open Source Fund
items.description: Claude Security, currently in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers, now runs codebase scans on Mythos 5. The post Anthropic Expands Mythos 5 Access to More Defenders, Unveils $35M Open Source Fund appeared first on SecurityWeek.
